meta.title: Line-origination strategy summary (reference to verified sibling-session work)
meta.note: This page summarizes the strategy work done in sibling sessions (root Line Lab, skill-lab, quant-lab, origination-lab, origination). It is a reference, not new results. No strategy passed validation gates. All gate/performance figures are quoted from those published sessions.
meta.scope: Single bets, parlays, player-prop combos; validation gates; correlation handling; leaderboard design.

strategies.name: Originated spread / total / moneyline (ratings model)
strategies.description: Walk-forward point-ratings model originating its own spread, total and moneyline from the official play-by-play feed. Settled at the closing line.
strategies.performance: Model worse than market close (root: model spread MAE 10.38 vs market 9.70; p=0.881 incremental information).

strategies.name: Same-game parlay (QB↔WR1, cover↔over)
strategies.description: Same-game parlay legs priced with empirical correlation (Gaussian copula) instead of assuming independence.
strategies.correlation_handling: QB↔WR1 r≈+0.56 to +0.67; cover↔over ≈+0.016; independent pricing understates joint probability (e.g. 4-leg same-team joint 11.1% vs 5.7% under independence).
strategies.performance: Not approved — correlation reduces edge; no combination cleared gates.

strategies.name: Player-prop combos
strategies.description: Prop combinations (e.g. player prop parlays) priced from originated quantiles.
strategies.correlation_handling: Cross-prop correlation not priced (no prop prices).
strategies.performance: Cannot be computed — no historical player-prop prices in public feed (blank, flagged).
strategies.source_status: official source confirms no public prop prices

strategies.name: Wind-under totals (lead, not result)
strategies.description: Outdoor wind ≥15 mph unders lead, evaluated on holdout.
strategies.performance: Lead only (+7.14% on 430 bets after price guard, p=0.125, 2/6 gates). Not a result; CI includes zero.
strategies.source: quant-lab/ (issue #19 fix); root Line Lab pages/flagged.html

strategies.name: Negative / leakage controls
strategies.description: Back-every-home and de-vigged baselines, plus a deliberate lookahead control, to confirm gates reject lucky-looking signals.
strategies.performance: Controls fail gates as intended (deliberate lookahead control +93.9% rejected by G1).
strategies.source: origination-lab/ (31 strategies, 0 gold); root Line Lab
